entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence length is 768 aa; estimated molecular weight is 84.3 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.32.
Pfam scanning detects HSL_N at residues 289–423 and Abhydrolase_3 at residues 612–757.
C-terminal region also matches BD-FAE and Say1_Mug180 families at residues 602–706.
No explicit catalytic reaction or sufficiently covered annotated homolog was retrieved; functional evidence grade is insufficient.

entities.name: Abhydrolase_3
observations: Pfam Abhydrolase_3 match spans residues 612–757 with i-Evalue 2.2e-32, strongly supporting an α/β-hydrolase-like catalytic domain.

entities.name: HSL_N
observations: Pfam HSL_N match spans residues 289–423 with i-Evalue 1.8e-07, indicating an N-terminal hormone-sensitive-lipase-like region.

entities.name: BD-FAE/Say1_Mug180
observations: Overlapping matches at residues 602–706 suggest a conserved C-terminal esterase/lipase-related region, but these family labels do not uniquely determine substrate specificity.

entities.name: Sulfamethoxazole
observations: SMILES identifies sulfamethoxazole, PubChem CID 5329 and ChEMBL CHEMBL443.
Clinical adverse-event evidence is commonly reported for trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole combination products rather than monotherapy.

entities.name: Sulfamethoxazole SOC screening
observations: Available molecule-profile output did not provide a machine-readable SIDER adverse-event table or detailed label adverse-reaction extraction; SOC predictions are label-informed screening results.

Positive screening classes: hepatobiliary, metabolism and nutrition, eye, musculoskeletal and connective tissue, gastrointestinal, immune system, vascular, blood and lymphatic, skin and subcutaneous tissue, respiratory/thoracic/mediastinal, psychiatric, renal and urinary, pregnancy/puerperium/perinatal, ear and labyrinth, cardiac, nervous system.
Negative screening classes: reproductive system and breast, neoplasms, endocrine, congenital/familial/genetic.
